skills.name: epd-best-practices
skills.description: Integrating EPD Commerce via the v1 REST API — auth, idempotency, error envelope, pagination, payments, subscriptions, refunds, security, versioning. Routes to per-domain references for detail.

skills.name: epd-webhooks
skills.description: Configuring, verifying, and debugging EPD Commerce webhook endpoints — HMAC-SHA256 signatures, replay protection, version upgrades, delivery log inspection. Includes Node, Python, and PHP verifier scripts.

skills.name: epd-quickstart
skills.description: First-time EPD Commerce integration — sandbox API key, customer/payment-method/product creation, first test charge, decline path validation.

skills.name: epd-mcp-operator
skills.description: Cross-cutting safety layer and router for the EPD Commerce MCP surface: tool selection, confirmation tiers, test-vs-live mode, idempotency, rate limiting, error envelopes, and permission errors. The workflow counterpart to epd-best-practices.

skills.name: epd-onboard-customer
skills.description: Operator-agent workflow over the EPD Commerce MCP server: vault a card, create the customer, attach the payment method, optionally make the first charge or start a subscription. References MCP tool names, not REST endpoints.

skills.name: epd-subscriptions
skills.description: Operator-agent workflow over the EPD Commerce MCP server: start subscriptions on existing customers, change payment method or billing cycle, cancel, recover past_due via the dunning loop.

skills.name: epd-refunds
skills.description: Operator-agent workflow over the EPD Commerce MCP server: decision tree across refund_order, refund_transaction, and refund_and_cancel.
